findings.evidence: Line 387 declares @[expose] def conjugate; lines 390–392 already characterize membership without unfolding.
findings.fix: Remove @[expose]; use the existing mem_conjugate characterization for downstream proofs.
findings.issue: Submodule.conjugate unnecessarily exposes its map-based implementation, allowing consumers to depend on its representation.

findings.evidence: Lines 78–82 characterize toConjHomeomorph and its inverse; conjugate_apply at line 118 characterizes only forward trivialization evaluation, with no corresponding inverse formula in the file.
findings.fix: Remove both @[expose] annotations. Retain the homeomorphism application lemmas and add a characteristic formula for the inverse of a conjugated trivialization so consumers can evaluate both directions without unfolding.
findings.issue: toConjHomeomorph and Trivialization.conjugate (line 105) expose bundled implementation bodies, making downstream proofs depend on representation details.

summary: Several bundled constructions expose implementation bodies despite having, or needing, characteristic lemmas that suffice for consumers.
